usedFor: Zoom holds meetings and webinars, and Hastewire rewrites text when “When a meeting summary is completed” runs “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting summary is completed” in Zoom, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A finished meeting summary gets reworded so it reads naturally.

watchOut: “When a meeting ends” fires for any meeting in the account, so narrow it before “Humanize Text”.
